translated_title: Labor Poverty in Mexico Stood at 31.9 Percent in the Second Quarter
original_title: Pobreza laboral en México se ubicó en 31.9 por ciento en el segundo trimestre
author: Clara Zepeda
meta_description: Down 3.2 points from a year earlier but up from Q1's two-decade low of 30.7%, with Chiapas, Oaxaca, and Guerrero still the hardest hit, INEGI reports.
